author: Blyth, 1849
habitat: 갈대밭, 물가 풀숲, 논과 묵논, 하천·저수지 가장자리의 습지
summary: 해마다 수십 마리가 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 갈대밭과 물가 풀숲, 논 같은 습지에서 겨울을 난다. 우거진 풀숲 속을 걸어 다니며 좀처럼 모습을 드러내지 않고, 놀라면 날기보다 풀숲으로 달아난다. 곤충, 지렁이, 작은 연체동물 같은 작은 동물과 물풀의 씨앗·새싹을 먹는다. 시베리아 동부와 몽골, 중국 동북부, 일본 북부에서 번식하고 일본 남부, 중국 남부, 동남아시아, 인도 동북부에서 겨울을 난다.

young: 어린새는 날개덮깃에 흰 가로띠가 더 많고 뚜렷하며, 얼굴과 가슴의 청회색이 옅고 아랫면 깃 가장자리가 연한 적갈색을 띤다.

art.subject: Brown-cheeked Rail (Rallus indicus), adult as seen in Korean winter wetlands (November–March): crown and upperparts olive-brown boldly streaked black; a pale grey supercilium above a broad brown stripe from the lores through the eye across the cheek; chin whitish; throat, foreneck and breast grey washed brownish; flanks and belly sides boldly barred black and white; undertail coverts whitish-buff barred dark. Long bill mostly bright orange-red with a dark ridge and tip; red iris; legs and long toes dull pinkish-red.
art.pose: walking slowly at the edge of reeds with tail cocked, side view, in the open
art.scene: Korean winter wetland: a narrow ditch and stream edge with dense dry reeds and sedges, thin ice at the margins, low winter light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, winter, side view walking at the edge of reeds with tail cocked: pale greyish supercilium, brown stripe through the eye, whitish chin, long bill orange-red below with a dark culmen, red iris, brown upperparts with blackish feather centres, grey breast washed brown, barred flanks, black-and-white barred undertail coverts

adult, head and breast detail in side view: pale greyish supercilium above a brown stripe from the lores through the eye onto the ear-coverts, whitish chin, grey breast washed brown, long bill with an orange-red lower mandible and dark upper ridge
art.build: Small, slim, laterally compressed rail, much smaller and slimmer than Common Moorhen, with a body about the size of a thrush. Small head, short neck. Bill long (clearly longer than the head), slender and very slightly decurved. Legs medium length with long toes. Short, pointed tail often cocked and flicked, showing the barred undertail. Wings short and rounded; rarely flies, preferring to run into cover.
avoid: Do not paint a short, stubby crake bill; the bill is long, slender and red-based.
Do not paint a plain grey face without the brown cheek stripe — that is Water Rail (Rallus aquaticus).
Do not paint a red frontal shield or a white flank line — that is Common Moorhen.
Do not paint a rufous breast; the breast is grey with a brownish wash.
